title: One personal apply across personal and AI sources

statements.text: A normal full plain chezmoi apply on the Mac mini applies the personal source and then the independently configured dotfiles-ai source.
The personal source owns one native always-run bridge; dotfiles-ai remains the exclusive owner of AI targets and is not modified by this slice.
Before secondary apply, require distinct source roots, the expected dotfiles-ai GitHub origin, and an empty managed leaf-target intersection.
Fast-forward only the current tracked dotfiles-ai branch with git pull --ff-only; never auto-pull the personal source or reset, stash, clean, switch, merge, or overwrite either working tree.
A dotfiles-ai pull or apply failure makes the outer apply fail visibly; already-applied personal targets are not falsely rolled back and a later retry converges.
A bounded environment guard prevents recursive source chaining; dotfiles-ai never invokes the personal source.
Do not chain targeted apply, dry-run, status, diff, edit, update, or non-Mac-mini personal-source operations.
Two independently managed sources share one destination; any future leaf-target overlap blocks chaining until ownership is reconciled.
